方芸的目光落向密室角落里那根最粗壮的水晶柱。

她抽出匕首，倒转刀柄，试探性地砸向水晶表面。

“铛！铛铛！铛。”

四声清脆的金属颤音在密室中回荡，节奏与岩画上的敲击感如出一辙。

下一秒，令人头皮发麻的咔咔声从石缝深处传来。

一只足有洗脸盆大小的巨型蜘蛛毫无征兆地从阴影中爬出，顿时让两人头皮发麻！

它浑身呈现出一种半透明的晶体质感，在火把的映照下折射出令人目眩的迷幻光泽。

八只复眼死死盯住两人，口器中发出低沉的嗡鸣。

【晶化蜘蛛（变异种）】

【品质：绿色】

【状态：中立单位，极度饥饿，可驯服】

许默眼底精光一闪。

他在储物空间里飞速翻找，掏出一块之前剩下的暗褐色铁矿石，用力抛向那只怪物。

沉重的矿石在地上滚了两圈，刚好停在蜘蛛脚下。

晶化蜘蛛猛地扑上去，两只锋利的螯肢死死抱住铁矿石。

令人牙酸的咀嚼声随之响起，坚硬的生铁在它嘴里竟像饼干一样被嚼得粉碎。

吃痛快了，这头半透明的怪物居然发出了细微嗡鸣声，紧接着便迈开八条腿，寸步不离地跟在了许默脚后跟。

【晶化蜘蛛，驯化度1/30】

白捡一个绿色品质的战宠，这一趟绝对回本。

许默打了个手势，两人带着蜘蛛转身退出密室，准备沿暗河原路折返。

就在许默的右脚刚刚踏上河岸湿滑卵石的瞬间。

墨黑色水面毫无预兆地轰然炸开。

漫天水花宛如暴雨般砸下，一股令人作呕的腥臭味夹杂着狂暴的杀气，直逼许默面门。

一条体长超过三米的盲眼鳄鱼犹如出膛的炮弹般从水底悍然杀出。

它浑身覆盖着暗蓝色的坚硬鳞甲，没有眼睛的面部只剩下一张长满倒刺的血盆大口。

【盲眼巨鳄（地下河霸主）】

【品质：蓝色】

【综合实力评估：82】

如果给许默抽刀抵抗的机会，这傻逼玩意早被一刀囊死了。

可综合实力的描述就是如此模糊。

这大块头太快了，根本来不及闪避。

许默只来得及将左臂猛地架在身前。

伴随着令人毛骨悚然的骨肉撕裂声，鳄鱼那咬合力惊人的巨颚死死咬住了他的左臂。

“嘶——！”

许默额头瞬间渗出一层冷汗。

Fang Yun's eyes fell on the thickest crystal pillar in the corner of the secret room.

She pulled out the dagger, turned the handle upside down, and tentatively struck the crystal surface.

"Clang! Clang! Cang."

Four crisp metallic vibratos echoed in the secret chamber, and the rhythm was exactly the same as the percussion on the rock paintings.

The next second, a scalp-numbing clicking sound came from deep within the cracks in the stone.

A giant spider the size of a washbasin crawled out of the shadows without warning, immediately making their scalps numb!

It has a translucent crystal texture all over its body, reflecting a dazzling psychedelic luster under the light of the torch.

The eight compound eyes stared at the two of them, and their mouthparts made a low hum.

[Crystalized spider (mutated species)]

[Quality: Green]

[Status: Neutral unit, extremely hungry, tamable]

Xu Mo's eyes flashed.

He rummaged quickly in the storage space, took out a piece of dark brown iron ore that was left before, and threw it at the monster.

The heavy ore rolled twice on the ground and stopped just at the spider's feet.

The crystallized spider pounced forward, its two sharp claws tightly hugging the iron ore.

A tooth-piercing chewing sound followed, and the hard pig iron was chewed into pieces like biscuits in its mouth.

After eating so much, the translucent monster actually made a slight buzzing sound, and then it spread out its eight legs and followed Xu Mo's heels.

[Crystalized spider, domestication degree 1/30]

Picking up a green-quality battle pet for nothing will definitely pay off.

Xu Mo made a gesture, and the two of them turned around and exited the secret room with the spider, preparing to return along the original path of the underground river.

The moment Xu Mo's right foot stepped onto the slippery pebbles on the river bank.

The jet-black water exploded without warning.

Water splashed down from the sky like a torrential rain, and a disgusting stench mixed with violent murderous intent came straight to Xu Mo's face.

A blind crocodile with a body length of more than three meters burst out of the water like a discharged cannonball.

Its whole body was covered with dark blue hard scales, and its eyeless face only had a bloody mouth covered with barbs.

[Blind Giant Crocodile (Underground River Overlord)]

[Quality: blue]

[Comprehensive strength assessment: 82]

If Xu Mo had been given a chance to draw a knife to resist, this idiot would have been killed by a knife.

But the description of comprehensive strength is so vague.

This big guy was so fast that he had no time to dodge.

Xu Mo only had time to put his left arm in front of him.

Accompanied by the blood-curdling sound of tearing bone and flesh, the crocodile's huge jaws with astonishing bite force bit his left arm.

"Hiss——!"

A layer of cold sweat instantly broke out on Xu Mo's forehead.
